content.short: Seamless Protocol is the primary native lending protocol on Base, featuring under-collateralized borrowing.
content.description: Seamless Protocol is the leading decentralized, non-custodial lending and borrowing platform built natively for the Base network. As a community-driven project with a focus on capital efficiency, the protocol introduces innovative Integrated Liquidity Markets (ILMs). These allow for specialized under-collateralized borrowing strategies that are pre-defined and transparently managed on-chain, reducing the capital required for sophisticated financial operations. Powered by the SEAM token, Seamless provides users with professional-grade liquidity tools and optimized interest rates.
content.meta: Seamless Protocol offers native decentralized lending and under-collateralized borrowing on Base. Discover Seamless Protocol on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
